name: agent-herder
description: Coordinate and supervise parent/child sessions across Claude, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Fast Agent, Hermes, and Qoder with MCP messaging, TTL coordination notes, session inspection, and autopilot.

interface.longDescription: Agent Herder monitors coding-agent sessions, lets agents message each other through MCP, injects TTL coordination notes for shared workspaces, resumes or steers sessions, and provides optional autopilot supervision.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my agent sessions and supervise the selected one.
